contracts: ((Replay is accepted only when fresh-checkout canonical result and all result-determining snapshot inputs match the recorded result.) AND (Validation proves the result references a complete Current Snapshot and rejects absent or partial bindings.) AND (两类受支持路由均可达并返回成功，且每个结果含 effective inspected content 标识。)) AND (A machine validator links each verdict to current source identity and a real command execution record.) AND (Non-executed evidence produces invalid aggregate with case identity.) AND (Prior identity is observed at disable/rollback and Candidate at re-enable.)
selector_intents: Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The fresh-checkout replay command exits successfully and its canonical result digest equals the recorded result digest. Expected: Re-running replay from the fresh checkout reproduces the recorded result with the same result-determining snapshot inputs.

Observable: VDD 与 Acceptance 路由 smoke 均返回成功结果，并包含 effective_content_digest 或等价内容绑定字段。 Expected: 路由到达可用处理器并返回成功响应，成功证据绑定实际检查内容。
Replay a result artifact with the Current Snapshot removed or truncated; validation must fail closed and identify incomplete binding.
Return a wrong route at disable, rollback, or re-enable and require identity-specific rejection.
Run replay from a clean checkout with a deliberately missing or altered snapshot input; the reproducibility check must fail deterministically.
Supply a present Matrix Case evidence record with executed=false and require aggregate invalid with case-specific diagnostic.
Validate a verdict with missing, stale, or mismatched source identity; governance validation must reject it.
